note: The frozen benchmark panel. Its opponents, its decks, its seeds and its game count never change, so a win rate against it is comparable across every future generation. Any edit to this file changes the digest and invalidates that comparison; say so in docs/learning.md when you make one.

protocol.note: 60 games per pairing is 15 seeds, each played from both seats and with the deck assignments swapped. No early stopping: a fixed sample is what makes two generations comparable.
